items.exampleEn: Her shooting was so good that she scored twenty points in the game.
items.exampleZh: 她投籃投得很準，在那場比賽拿下二十分。
items.glossZh: 投籃、射門；（電影）拍攝；射擊

items.exampleEn: The museum shows an old treaty written on animal skin.
items.exampleZh: 博物館展出一份寫在獸皮上的古老條約。

items.exampleEn: In law, assault means attacking or threatening to attack someone.
items.exampleZh: 在法律上，assault 指攻擊或威脅攻擊他人。

items.exampleEn: The company faced a scandal after it hid problems with its cars.
items.exampleZh: 那家公司隱瞞汽車的問題後，爆發了醜聞。

items.exampleEn: The museum has a room about the city's wartime bombing.
items.exampleZh: 博物館有一間展室介紹這座城市戰時遭轟炸的歷史。

items.exampleEn: The company is a legitimate business with a real office.
items.exampleZh: 那是一家有實體辦公室的正當公司。

items.exampleEn: The soccer club banned fans who threw bottles onto the field.
items.exampleZh: 那家足球俱樂部禁止向場內丟瓶子的球迷進場。

items.exampleEn: In the game, two weaker players made an alliance to beat the strongest one.
items.exampleZh: 在那場遊戲裡，兩個較弱的玩家結盟，聯手打敗最強的那一個。

items.sentenceEn: The coach told us to practice our shooting before every game.
items.sentenceZh: 教練要我們每場比賽前都練習射門。

items.audioEn: Phones are banned during the exam, so please leave them in your bag at the back.
items.audioZh: 考試期間不准使用手機，請把手機放在後面的包包裡。

items.sentenceEn: The man was charged with assault after a fight outside a bar.
items.sentenceZh: 那名男子在酒吧外打架後，被以傷害罪起訴。

items.sentenceEn: In history class, we learned how the city was rebuilt after the bombing.
items.sentenceZh: 歷史課上，我們學到這座城市在轟炸後如何重建。

items.stemEn: The two countries signed a peace ____ more than two hundred years ago.
items.stemZh: 這兩個國家在兩百多年前簽訂了和平條約。

items.stemEn: Is a long line a ____ excuse for being late to an interview?
items.stemZh: 排隊排很久，算是面試遲到的正當理由嗎？

items.passageEn: Last summer, a film crew came to our town to shoot a historical movie about an old peace treaty. The shooting lasted three weeks, and cars were banned from the main square every afternoon. Some shop owners complained, but the film company paid them a fee, which they agreed was a legitimate way to solve the problem. Later, a small scandal broke out when a newspaper reported that one actor had copied his speech from an old book. Still, the town and the film company formed a kind of alliance: the town promised help, and the company promised to show the film here first.
items.passageZh: 去年夏天，一個拍攝團隊來我們鎮上拍一部關於古老和平條約的歷史電影。拍攝持續了三週，每天下午主廣場都禁止汽車通行。有些店家抱怨，不過電影公司付了他們一筆費用，店家也同意這是解決問題的合理方式。後來，一家報紙報導有位演員的台詞是從一本舊書抄來的，引發了一場小醜聞。儘管如此，小鎮和電影公司還是建立起某種聯盟關係：小鎮承諾協助拍攝，電影公司則承諾先在這裡放映電影。

questions.questionZh: 電影公司怎麼解決店家的抱怨？
小鎮和電影公司各承諾了什麼？
options: 小鎮宣傳電影，公司修廣場
小鎮出錢，公司請鎮民當演員
小鎮蓋新戲院，公司拍續集
小鎮協助拍攝，公司先在這裡放映

items.promptZh: 這家咖啡館禁止在室內吸菸。
referenceEn: This cafe bans smoking anywhere inside.
Smoking is banned inside this cafe.
rubricZh: ban 可當動詞或名詞（例如 bans smoking、is banned、a ban on smoking 等）

items.promptZh: 他的抱怨很合理，經理應該聽一聽。
referenceEn: His complaint is legitimate, so the manager should listen to it.
He has a legitimate complaint, and the manager should listen to him.
rubricZh: legitimate 表示「正當的、合理的」，可放名詞前或 be 動詞後（例如 a legitimate complaint 等）
「應該」可寫，例如 should、ought to 等
